walkthrough.use_case: Compare two hotel screenshots against a budget, location preference and cancellation requirement.
walkthrough.steps:
Open ChatGPT in the Chat tab and check that GPT-6.2 is available on your paid account.
Use + then Add photos & files to attach non-sensitive screenshots of two hotel options.
Ask: “Compare these two stays for a three-night trip. Prioritize total price, walking distance to the station, and free cancellation. Put the evidence in a table and mark anything you cannot verify from the screenshots.”
Check each uncertain price, location and cancellation term on the hotels’ current booking pages before deciding.
walkthrough.availability: GPT-6.2 rolling out to eligible Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise Chat users; Enterprise admins may control access.
walkthrough.limitations: OpenAI reports improvements but this episode does not independently measure them. Image details and web findings may be wrong or stale. We reviewed documentation and did not run a live GPT-6.2 comparison.

youtube_description:
On November 23, OpenAI began rolling GPT-6.2 into the ChatGPT Chat tab for eligible Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users. OpenAI reports better handling of detailed instructions, image questions and difficult web research. This Chat update is separate from GPT-6.2 Astra in ChatGPT Work.

A practical first check: add screenshots of two hotel options, give ChatGPT your budget, preferred location and cancellation needs, and ask for a side-by-side comparison with uncertain details flagged. The example is a source-based walkthrough, not our live test of GPT-6.2. Image input was already available in ChatGPT; the new release is the chat-tuned model, not a new upload button.

GPT-6.2 is rolling out on eligible paid plans; Enterprise access depends on admin settings. Confirm current prices, room availability and cancellation policies directly on the hotel sites before booking.

OpenAI release notes: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/6825453-chatgpt-release-notes
